title: Sort an Array
summary: Provide an array of integers, nums, and return it sorted in ascending order, ensuring the sorting algorithm runs in O(nlog(n)) time and uses minimal space.
statement: Provide an array of integers, nums, and return it sorted in ascending order, ensuring the sorting algorithm runs in O(nlog(n)) time and uses minimal space.
constraints: Return all integers in nondecreasing order.
Do not rely on bounded value ranges.
hints: Divide until lists have at most one element.
Recursively sort both halves, then merge their smallest fronts.
Append the smaller head until one half is exhausted, then append the remainder.
Induction proves each returned half and their merge are sorted and complete.
editorial: Induction proves each returned half and their merge are sorted and complete.

tests.explanation: Duplicates are retained in nondecreasing order.
